meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: Claude 会持续盯住一个 Pull Request:反复检查评论、评审和 CI,修复真实问题、运行测试后推送新提交,直到全部问题解决、可以合并才停,并报告提交号、检查结果等证据。
howto.when: 当你用 "babysit" 或 "monitor" 等词,要求它持续查看某个 Pull Request 的评论、评审和 CI 直到问题解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我盯住 PR #42,CI 跑完、评审都解决了再告诉我。
say.note: 它会进入持续检查模式,直到可合并。

say.text: 监控这个 PR,新评论别放过,有问题就直接修。
say.note: 它会核查评论并修复真实问题再推送。

say.text: 盯着 #88 的评审线程,没解决的都处理掉,能合并了汇报。
say.note: 结束后给出提交号、检查结果等证据。

howto.what_en: Claude keeps watching a pull request's reviews, comments, and CI, fixing real issues, running tests, and pushing commits, stops when nothing actionable remains, then reports evidence like commit SHA and check results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to babysit or monitor something, or to keep checking a pull request's comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Watch PR #42 and report back once CI passes and reviews are resolved.
say_en.note: It keeps polling and handling the PR until it can merge.

say_en.text: Babysit this PR and handle new comments until it's ready to merge.
say_en.note: It re-checks review threads and fixes real issues.

say_en.text: Stay on #88 until it can merge; fix issues and report evidence at the end.
say_en.note: It reports the latest commit SHA, check results, etc.
